title: A high-confidence plant mitochondrial proteome via protein correlation profiling
title_zh: 通过蛋白质相关性剖析构建高置信度植物线粒体蛋白组
abstract: Plant mitochondria share many features with animal mitochondria but also possess unique traits, including presence of both circular and linear mitochondrial DNA, RNA editing, a branched electron transport chain, and metabolic pathways supporting photosynthesis. An accurate mitochondrial proteome is crucial for studying these conserved and lineage-specific functions. Here, we introduce a novel approach to defining plant mitoproteomes that combines serial mitochondrial enrichment, mass spectrometry, and protein correlation profiling. This approach allows us to experimentally define a mitochondrial protein inventory of 1,462 proteins with high sensitivity and specificity. Integration of our experimental inventory with literature and microscopy validation yields the Arabidopsisthaliana MitoCarta (AtMitoCarta) atlas of 1,609 mitochondrial proteins, including 236 newly defined proteins and 147 proteins of unknown functions. A comparative analysis across eukaryotic organisms reveals that 15% of mitochondrial protein families are plant specific, including expanded pentatricopeptide repeat proteins. The AtMitoCarta inventory and the experimental workflow applicable to wild-type plants will enable comparative studies of plant mitochondria.
abstract_zh: 植物线粒体与动物线粒体共享许多特征，但也具有独特的属性，包括同时存在环状和线性线粒体DNA、RNA编辑、分支电子传递链以及支持光合作用的代谢通路。准确的线粒体蛋白组对于研究这些保守和谱系特异性功能至关重要。本文提出了一种新方法，结合连续线粒体富集、质谱分析和蛋白质相关性剖析，来定义植物线粒体蛋白组。该方法使我们能够实验性地确定1,462种线粒体蛋白，具有高灵敏度和特异性。将我们的实验库存与文献和显微镜验证相结合，得到阿拉伯芥（Arabidopsis thaliana）MitoCarta（AtMitoCarta）图谱，包含1,609种线粒体蛋白，其中包括236种新定义蛋白和147种功能未知蛋白。跨真核生物的比较分析显示，15%的线粒体蛋白家族为植物特异性，包括扩增的五聚体重复蛋白。AtMitoCarta库存及其适用于野生型植物的实验流程将为植物线粒体的比较研究提供基础。
